result.topic_en: Riemann argues that if the theta function vanishes identically at the shifted argument (sums of Abel integrals), then all of its first partial derivatives must vanish as well. He then forms a quotient of four theta functions and shows it equals a product of rational functions in the two point systems, $\varrho(s_1,z_1)\varrho(\sigma_1,\zeta_1)$.
